_note: Data tables for dashboard/model.js. main.ts passes them to the model and writes them into data.js, so the page runs on the same tables. act[kind] = [main position, second action, how to unwind it, what to check before any spend, [stress event, share of capital it costs]].

vault: Deposit {S} of USDC into the largest USDC vault {N} curates on {C}, straight from the vault page
Put a second, smaller deposit of {s} into another {N} vault (an ETH or BTC one) so the wallet holds two curated positions
redeem both vault shares from the vault page (some vaults queue withdrawals for a day or two)
on {C}, {N} lists a USDC vault you can enter without a whitelist, its withdrawal terms (instant or queued) are shown, and its points page names vault deposits as eligible
a 2% haircut if the curator takes a bad-debt loss or the withdrawal queue forces a discounted exit
lend: Supply {S} of USDC to {N} on {C} and turn it on as collateral
Borrow {s} of a stablecoin against it and keep the health factor above 2.0: borrowing is the activity lenders usually reward most
repay the borrow first, then withdraw the USDC
{N} on {C} accepts USDC as supply and as collateral, the market is not paused or at its supply cap, and its points page names supplying or borrowing as eligible
a liquidation of the borrow at a 5% penalty if the health factor is left to fall below 1.0
dex: Add {S} to a stablecoin or ETH pair on {N} on {C}, with a wide range if the pool is concentrated
Make one swap of about {s} a week through {N} so the wallet logs volume as well as liquidity
remove the liquidity and swap any leftover pair token back to USDC
{N} on {C} has a stablecoin or ETH pool with at least $1M of liquidity, the pool earns points (not only fees), and a $1,000 test swap quotes under 0.3% price impact
impermanent loss of about 0.6% of the liquidity if the pair's price moves 25% (2√1.25/2.25 − 1)
deriv: Deposit {S} of USDC as margin on {N} on {C}
Each week open and close a small hedged trade of about {s} notional (long and short at 1-2x), fees near 0.05% a side
close every open position, then withdraw the margin
{N} on {C} accepts USDC margin from your region without KYC you cannot pass, shows its maker and taker fees, and names trading volume or open interest as eligible for points
90 days of funding at 0.01% per 8 hours on the hedge leg, about 2.7% of its notional
predict: Deposit {S} of USDC on {N} on {C} and hold it as the account balance
Each week buy and later sell about {s} of shares across two or three liquid markets, so the wallet logs trading volume
sell or let resolve any open shares, then withdraw the balance
{N} is open to your region, accepts USDC on {C}, and states that trading volume or holding positions counts for its rewards
markets resolving against open positions, up to 10% of the weekly share amount
stable: Mint or deposit {S} into {N}'s yield-bearing dollar on {C}
If {N}'s app lists a pool or money market for the receipt, move {s} there (many points programs count it twice); if none, keep it all in step 2
pull the receipt back from any pool, then redeem it for USDC (some issuers redeem in 1-7 days)
{N}'s yield-bearing dollar can be minted and redeemed on {C} by retail (not only whitelisted firms), its redemption delay is stated, and holding it earns points
a 3% depeg of the yield-bearing dollar at the moment you redeem
rwa: Complete {N}'s onboarding (KYC where it asks; review often takes 1-2 days) and subscribe {S} to its tokenized yield product on {C}
Hold the token in the wallet the issuer whitelisted; only if {N} names a market that takes it as collateral, post {s} there
request redemption from the issuer (settlement often T+1 to T+3) or sell on its secondary market
{N} onboards retail investors from your country, its minimum subscription is at or under your deposit, redemption terms are published, and holders are named as eligible for rewards
a 1% redemption fee plus a week of settlement delay at exit
stake: Stake {S} worth of the native asset through {N} on {C} and keep the liquid receipt
If {N} lists a DeFi pool that accepts the receipt, deposit {s} there so the stake counts twice; if none, hold the receipt
withdraw the receipt from any pool, then unstake (expect the protocol's unbonding wait) or sell the receipt on a DEX
{N} stakes the native asset on {C} with a liquid receipt, states its unbonding period, and names staked balances as eligible for points
1% slashing of the staked balance, or selling the receipt 1% under par to skip unbonding
infra: Move {S} onto {C} through {N} (bridge, deposit or channel, whichever it offers) and keep it there
Use {s} of it in two other apps on {C} each week, so the wallet looks like a user, not a one-off deposit
move the funds back the same way and send them to an exchange
{N} has a working deposit or bridge route onto {C} for USDC, publishes its fees and withdrawal time, and runs a points or rewards program for users of that route
a 2% loss if the bridge or deposit route is paused or exploited with funds in transit
